name: Image Optimizer, WebP Converter & Compression – Toolszu
author: Toolszu

sections.description:
Image Optimizer, WebP Converter & Compression – Toolszu is a lightweight WordPress image compression, resizing, and WebP conversion plugin designed for content writers, bloggers, and performance-focused websites.

The plugin automatically resizes large uploads, compresses them, converts them to WebP format, targets specific KB sizes, and includes a powerful bulk optimizer for existing media library images. Perfect for improving Core Web Vitals, page speed, and overall website performance.

Key Features

  • Smart Dimension Resizing: Scales down oversized uploads to the maximum width you choose (default 1200px, or off).
  • Correct Photo Rotation: Phone photos keep the right orientation after optimization.
  • Automatic Image Compression: Compresses JPG and PNG images on upload.
  • Next-Gen WebP Converter: Converts new JPG & PNG uploads to WebP automatically (kept only when smaller).
  • Strict KB Size Targeting: Target a maximum file size (e.g., 150KB).
  • Safe Bulk Optimizer: Compresses existing images and all their thumbnails in place, so images in your posts keep working.
  • Savings Report: See how much each image was reduced in the Media Library, plus totals on the settings page.
  • Original Image Backups: Optional backup of originals, for uploads and bulk optimization.
  • Uses WordPress’s own image editor: Works with Imagick or GD, whichever your server has.
  • Content-Writer Friendly: Clean, beginner-friendly settings page with no external scripts or fonts.

Why Use This Image Optimizer?

Large images slow down websites and hurt SEO rankings. Toolszu Image Optimizer ensures your images are lightweight and properly scaled while maintaining visual quality. Whether you’re running a blog, news website, or content-heavy site, this plugin helps you:

  • Improve page load speed
  • Reduce server storage usage
  • Boost user experience
  • Support better SEO performance
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → Toolszu Image Optimizer
  4. Configure compression settings
  5. Start optimizing your images
sections.faq:
Does this plugin keep original images?

Yes, you can enable the option to keep original image backups.

Does it automatically convert images to WebP?

Yes. JPG and PNG images can be automatically converted to WebP on upload.

Does it resize the physical width of my images?

Yes. The plugin will automatically scale down excessively large images to a maximum width to save bandwidth and improve rendering times.

Can I optimize old images?

Yes. Use the bulk optimization tool to optimize images already in your media library. It compresses the full image and every thumbnail in their current format, at the same file name and address, so the images inside your existing posts and pages keep working.

Does the bulk optimizer convert old images to WebP?

No. Changing the format of images that are already used in posts would break those posts, so WebP conversion is applied to new uploads only.

Where can I see how much space was saved?

Go to Media → Library, switch to the list view and look at the “Toolszu” column. Totals are shown at the top of Settings → Toolszu Optimizer.

Will image quality be reduced?

The plugin uses smart compression to maintain high visual quality while drastically reducing file size.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Fix: The bulk optimizer no longer converts existing images to WebP or deletes the original file. It now compresses images and their thumbnails in place, so images already used in posts keep working.
  • Fix: “Keep original backup” now also works for the bulk optimizer. Backups keep their folders (toolszu-backups/2026/11/…).
  • Fix: Phone photos keep the correct rotation after optimization.
  • New: Maximum width setting (default 1200px, 0 = keep the original width).
  • New: Savings column in the Media Library and totals on the settings page.
  • New: A file is only replaced when the optimized version is smaller.
  • Improved: Uses the WordPress image editor (Imagick or GD).
  • Improved: Refreshed settings page; no external scripts or fonts are loaded any more.
  • Improved: “Settings” link on the Plugins page and clean removal of settings when the plugin is deleted.

1.1.2

  • Added a new “Connect With Us” widget to the settings sidebar.
  • Integrated Font Awesome for flawless social media icon rendering.

1.1.0

  • NEW: Added Automatic Dimension Resizing. The plugin now automatically scales down massively wide images (e.g., 4000px) to a web-friendly maximum width (1200px) before compressing, drastically improving image quality and server speed.

1.0.0

Initial release of Toolszu Image Optimizer.
– Automatic compression
– WebP conversion
– Bulk optimization
– Backup option
